title: Parametry parsera zmieniają interpretację, lecz nie identyfikator metody ani rewizji wyniku

evidence.observation: Same exact synthetic CSV bytes and logical_id, csv_delimiter comma vs semicolon: /0/0 is a;b vs a, while field_id, method_id and task.source_revision are identical. Root descriptor does retain parser_options; produced_by method identity omits them.

impact: A result cannot distinguish two different parsing recipes through its produced_by method and derived revision identity. Merging or comparing the same field ID can conflate incompatible interpretations; native receipts remain separately retained and this test does not claim native data loss.

alternatives.option: canonical effective parser/mapping parameters in versioned recipe hash
alternatives.status: required but absent from tested method identity

alternatives.option: preserve both interpretations with separate method identity and explicit selection
alternatives.status: syntax alternatives recognized; domain selection not yet published

target_data_graph: Existing analysis_method entity, produced_by claim and resource_field version; effective parser parameters bound to exact source/selector/mapping.
reproduction: run.py D4-17A: project the same a;b\n1;2\n bytes with csv_delimiter comma and semicolon; compare actual method and field IDs.
acceptance: D4-17B requires differing recipe/method and derived revision IDs when effective interpretation parameters differ; preserve exact raw source hash and old receipts. Same options with object keys permuted must remain equivalent.
migration: Introduce versioned recipe identity additively; do not rewrite old receipts. Mark legacy recipes without bound parameters as incomplete; retain root parser_options for reconstruction where available.
risk: Ambiguous provenance, field collisions and false equivalence after parameter changes.
dependencies: existing GraphPacket identity and version contracts
recommendation: Bind effective syntax options, including defaults actually consumed, to method/result identity; preserve raw source identity independently.

title: Podmiana dozwolonej ścieżki na symlink omija local_roots przed rzeczywistym odczytem
kind: confirmed deterministic synthetic filesystem TOCTOU reproduction

evidence.observation: Access.authorize_local resolves an in-root file; at actual os.open a deterministic test hook replaces it with symlink to another synthetic file outside allowed root. Original _local follows link, reads outside bytes and returns available. fstat checks only regular-file type and before/after stability of the opened outside file.

impact: A concurrently writable allowed directory can redirect this local read outside the caller-authorized root. No private file or real attack target was read; finding is about actual returned synthetic bytes.

alternatives.option: directory-descriptor / no-follow or equivalent open with verified ancestry and object identity
trusted immutable source handles with explicit authorization of opened object
alternatives.status: potential implementation alternative, not required API name

alternatives.option: document race as residual risk only
alternatives.status: insufficient for claimed local_roots authorization boundary

target_data_graph: Source access permission/policy applied to exact opened resource identity, with unavailable/changed outcome on mismatch.
reproduction: run.py D4-18A injects scheduling at os.open only, then calls original OS open/read against synthetic files. No copy of Access implementation.
acceptance: D4-18B: same deterministic race returns explicit rejection and no out-of-root data; retain successful authorized files and denied pre-existing symlinks. Extend platform-specific tests to parent-directory replacement.
migration: No schema migration necessary; preserve legitimate paths via a documented secure-open policy. New failures for concurrently replaced paths are explicit unavailable/changed, never empty.
risk: Unauthorized local source disclosure through race; platform-specific symlink/open semantics.
recommendation: Bind root authorization to the actual opened object and fail if directory or target identity cannot be verified. Do not disable local_roots to make test pass.

title: Referencja bez odczytu oraz wybrana projekcja działają przez istniejący native store

evidence.observation: Attach and reference packet require zero reads and zero materialized fields. Actual demand projection crosses unchanged GraphPacket/NativeGraphStore C ABI into SQLite, closes/reopens and replays without original source. Nested ZIP and inline retain source structure; cache/index/snapshot remain separate choices in covered cases.

impact: D is a scoped extension of the existing store, not a second persistent graph. Caller-selective materialization works without mandatory embed; this does not prove a seekable parser, domain importer parity or ordinary runtime activation.

alternatives.option: embedded captured snapshot offline without cache/index
domain mapping/discovery and native catalog dispatch

target_data_graph: Existing resource/analysis_method/resource_field entities, contains/produced_by claims and source observations in GraphPacket/KnowledgeStore.
reproduction: run.py D4-01/04/05/15/16/21 are direct contract/integration tests, not defect reproduction.
acceptance: Passed narrowly for actual consumers above; no claim that D closes CH-RES-N001/N002 or A3-WEB-001.
migration: Additive resource graph packets; source bytes untouched; pre-existing main wrappers reused unchanged.
risk: Overstating generic syntax projection as completed domain integration or whole-document parse as seekable partial IO.
dependencies: B-specific actual shared library manifest for second seam run
